title: BEFEHL: DURCHBRUCH ZUM SCHLUCHTKOPF
note: The Canyon v2 winter run as a mission (docs/MISSIONS.md). Places are the course's own authored geography (manifest_edits.json canyon_course / street_encounter): the wreck field marker, the hamlet at 12 % of the route, the choke-1 gun line and its kill-zone fork, platoon B's factory yard, platoon A's final basin by the strongpoint, the goal disc. Fiction: the Tiger is the rearguard of a Kampfgruppe that went up the ravine at first light; its rear party holds the ravine head and signals phase lines with flares (white: held, red: enemy on it). Flares and smoke are modeled emitters; alerts change real enemy knowledge; nothing else is scripted.
order: Panzer 231, rearguard of the Kampfgruppe. Crew: you alone. The column went up the ravine at first light; you are the last vehicle.

Soviet tanks and 45 mm guns have cut the ravine at the settlement, the saddle and the factory. The rear party holds the ravine head: a white star over each phase line it still holds, a red one where the enemy stands.
Break through to the ravine head, 4.9 km: north to the hamlet, then east. Arrive mounted before dark. Nothing waits for you behind.

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Column is through the hamlet. Read the ground, then follow the wrecks north. Out.

consequence.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Armour coming down the ravine toward you. Out.

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Phase line Anton is the hamlet, 450 metres north. White star marks it. Out.

done.text: Kiebitz at Anton. Two guns on the settlement edge ahead. Smoke marks the lorry they killed at the fork. Out.

consequence.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Armour on the road behind Anton. Out.

beats.title: The gun line at the fork

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Guns at the settlement, east bank of the fork. Take them from the flank, do not drive the road. Out.

done.text: Adler, Kiebitz. Gun silenced. Continuing. Out.

consequence.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Armour moving up behind you. Do not stop. Out.

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Two T-34 in the factory yard across the saddle. Red star over the yard. Clear it, or go round by the east wall. Out.

consequence.text: Kiebitz, Adler. More armour moving up the ravine behind you. Do not stop. Out.

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Rear party pulling off the strongpoint. Three T-34 in the basin between you and us. Red star where they stand. Out.

done.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Basin clear. Ravine head 500 metres east, white star. Come through. Out.

nudge.text: Kiebitz, Adler. We cannot hold the head much longer. Out.

consequence.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Armour behind you in the basin. Out.

open.text: Kiebitz, Adler. White star on the head. Come through. Out.

nudge.text: Kiebitz, Adler. Star on the head. Out.
